SELECT COUNT(1) FROM account2;

WITH last_month_activity AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT evm_address
    FROM account2
    WHERE last_sent_epoch >= extract(epoch from current_date - interval '1 month')
)
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lma.evm_address IS NOT NULL THEN a.evm_address END) AS "Active Accounts",
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lma.evm_address IS NULL THEN a.evm_address END) AS "Stale Accounts"
FROM
    account2 a
LEFT JOIN
    last_month_activity lma ON a.evm_address = lma.evm_address;
-- The CTE (Common Table Expression) named last_month_activity selects distinct Evmos addresses (evm_address) from the account2 table where the last transaction epoch is within the last month.
-- The main query counts the number of distinct Evmos addresses for both active and stale accounts using a LEFT JOIN with the last_month_activity CTE.
-- This query assumes that the timestamp-related columns (first_detected_epoch, last_sent_epoch, etc.) are stored as epoch timestamps (seconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC).

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "Last 24 Hours"
FROM
  account2
WHERE
  first_detected_epoch >= EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day');

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "Last 7 Days"
FROM
  account2
WHERE
  first_detected_epoch >= EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - INTERVAL '1 week');

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "Last 30 Days"
FROM
  account2
WHERE
  first_detected_epoch >= EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - INTERVAL '1 month');

SELECT
    t.account_address,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM (
    SELECT
        UNNEST(involved_accounts_addresses) AS account_address
    FROM
        $transaction_partition
) AS t
JOIN
    account2 a ON t.account_address = a.evm_address
GROUP BY
    t.account_address
ORDER BY
    transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

targets.rawSql:
WITH matched_records AS (
    SELECT
        sc.creator_evm_addr,
        t.gas_used
    FROM
        smart_contract sc
    JOIN
        $transaction_partition t ON sc.creator_evm_addr = ANY (t.involved_accounts_addresses)
    WHERE
        sc.verified_epoch IS NOT NULL AND sc.verified_epoch > 0
)
SELECT
    creator_evm_addr,
    AVG(gas_used) AS average_gas_used
FROM
    matched_records
GROUP BY
    creator_evm_addr;

SELECT 
    COUNT(sc.addr) AS "Last 24 hours"
FROM 
    smart_contract sc
JOIN 
    block b ON sc.height = b.height
WHERE 
    verified_epoch IS NOT NULL 
    AND verified_epoch > 0
    AND b.epoch >= EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day');

SELECT 
    COUNT(sc.addr) AS "Last 7 Days"
FROM 
    smart_contract sc
JOIN 
    block b ON sc.height = b.height
WHERE 
    verified_epoch IS NOT NULL 
    AND verified_epoch > 0
    AND b.epoch >= EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - INTERVAL '1 week');

SELECT 
    COUNT(sc.addr) AS "Last 30 Days"
FROM 
    smart_contract sc
JOIN 
    block b ON sc.height = b.height
WHERE 
    verified_epoch IS NOT NULL 
    AND verified_epoch > 0
    AND b.epoch >= EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - INTERVAL '1 month');

SELECT 
    COUNT(sc.addr) AS "Last Year"
FROM 
    smart_contract sc
JOIN 
    block b ON sc.height = b.height
WHERE 
    verified_epoch IS NOT NULL 
    AND verified_epoch > 0
    AND b.epoch >= EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - INTERVAL '1 year');

SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('day', TO_TIMESTAMP(epoch)) AS time,
  AVG(base_fee) AS "Average Base Fee"
FROM
  block
GROUP BY
  DATE_TRUNC('day', TO_TIMESTAMP(epoch))
ORDER BY
  time;

SELECT SUM(t_value_h + t_value_l*POWER(10, -18)) AS "Volume In EVMOS"
FROM $transaction_partition

SELECT SUM(t_value_h + t_value_l*POWER(10, -18))*$evmos_to_usd_rate AS "Volume In $"
FROM transaction_55

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "Last 24 hours"
FROM
  $transaction_partition

  epoch >= EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day');

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "Last 30 Days"
FROM
  transaction_55

  epoch >= EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - INTERVAL '1 month');

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "Last Year"
FROM

SELECT AVG(t.fee_amount * POWER(10, -18)) AS "Avg Tx Fee (EVMOS)"
FROM (
  SELECT (jsonb_array_elements((fee::jsonb)->'amount')->>'amount')::numeric AS fee_amount
  FROM $transaction_partition
  WHERE success = true
  LIMIT 1000
) t

SELECT AVG(t.fee_amount * POWER(10, -18) * $evmos_to_usd_rate) AS "Avg Tx Fee ($)"
FROM (
  SELECT (jsonb_array_elements((fee::jsonb)->'amount')->>'amount')::numeric AS fee_amount
  FROM $transaction_partition
  WHERE success = true
  LIMIT 1000
) t

SELECT count(1) AS "Tx Count"
FROM $transaction_partition

SELECT count(1) AS "Successful Tx Count"
FROM $transaction_partition
WHERE success = true

SELECT count(1) AS "Failed Tx Count"
FROM $transaction_partition
WHERE success = false

SELECT
  COUNT(hash) FILTER (WHERE category = 'distribution') AS "Distribution",
  COUNT(hash) FILTER (WHERE category = 'ethermint') AS "Ethermint",
  COUNT(hash) FILTER (WHERE category = 'gov') AS "Governance",
  COUNT(hash) FILTER (WHERE category = 'staking') AS "Staking",
  COUNT(hash) FILTER (WHERE category = '0x') AS "EVM",
  COUNT(hash) FILTER (WHERE category = 'ibc') AS "IBC",
  COUNT(hash) FILTER (WHERE category = 'rt') AS "RT",
  COUNT(hash) FILTER (WHERE category = 'other') AS "Other"
FROM (
  SELECT
    hash,
    CASE
      WHEN type_summary LIKE '%distribution%' THEN 'distribution'
      WHEN type_summary LIKE '%ethermint%' THEN 'ethermint'
      WHEN type_summary LIKE '%gov%' THEN 'gov'
  		WHEN type_summary LIKE '%staking%' THEN 'staking'
 		  WHEN type_summary LIKE '%0x%' THEN '0x'
  		WHEN type_summary LIKE '%ibc%' THEN 'ibc'
      WHEN type_summary LIKE 'RT' THEN 'rt'
      ELSE 'other'
    END AS category
  FROM
    $transaction_partition
) AS categorized_transactions;

SELECT
   day,
   SUM(transactions) / SUM(duration_seconds) AS "Average Tx Throughput Per Second"
FROM (
   SELECT
      date_trunc('day', TO_TIMESTAMP(epoch)) AS day,
      COUNT(*) AS transactions,
      (MAX(epoch) - MIN(epoch))::double precision AS duration_seconds
   FROM
      $transaction_partition
   GROUP BY
      day
) AS subquery
GROUP BY
   day
ORDER BY
   day
